current_main_milestone.meaning: Universal Intake and deterministic frontside inspection are integrated into the full D.RAW suite

core_vision.sealed_source_role: immutable evidence foundation, not the boundary of the reconstructed world
core_vision.backside: bytes, container, metadata, CFA/raster/calibration hints and format-adapter routing
core_vision.frontside: visible proportions, luminance, colour/light statistics, edges, structure and later deterministic classical geometry
core_vision.free_world_rule: representation may exceed the source; knowledge claims may not exceed the evidence

next_priorities: broaden format-neutral RAW decoding through validated adapters without device maps
deepen deterministic frontside understanding with classical colour, optics, geometry and scene-structure analysis
bind frontside and backside knowledge into one universal source-understanding state without authority collapse
preserve and extend F64 compute to controlled F32 scientific RAW/state
keep D.RAWnegative/Open Scene/continuous-field research above the Scientific Master without confusing reconstruction with measurement
keep branding and PURE/ADVANCED/PRO as the canonical user-facing app
